name: vcc-prover
description: Client-side zero-knowledge UltraHonk prover for privacy-preserving methodology compute.
long_description: TypeScript client-side zero-knowledge prover powered by NoirJS and bb.js (Wasm). Exposes status, prove, and verify tools to Claude. Runs entirely inside Node.js; private activity values and salts never leave your local machine.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Report whether the local Wasm toolchain (NoirJS and bb.js) is initialized and ready to prove.

tools.name: prove
tools.description: Produce a zero-knowledge UltraHonk proof package from private activity data. Private data and salts are saved to ~/.vcc/private/ and never disclosed.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Verify an UltraHonk proof locally using in-memory verification keys with bb.js.
